original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a clear glass container placed on a dark surface, likely a table or countertop. Inside the container, there is a dark liquid, possibly coffee or tea, with visible bubbles forming at the top. The liquid appears to be swirling slightly, indicating some movement or disturbance. As the video progresses, a white substance, which could be cream or milk, is poured into the container from above. This addition causes the liquid to become frothy and the bubbles to increase in number and size. The pouring action is smooth and steady, suggesting it was done carefully. The background remains consistently dark throughout the video, keeping the focus entirely on the container and its contents. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a fixed position, providing a stable and clear view of the pouring process.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a transparent cylindrical container resting on a flat surface against a dark, blurred background. Inside, an opaque dark liquid fills the lower portion, topped by a jagged surface where a white fluffy mass sits, while water droplets cling to the inner walls and a rounded bright reflection stays fixed on the lower left. A thin vertical dark line appears near the top center and progressively extends downward through the white mass. As it presses in, the single broad lobe of the white material deforms, splitting into two rounded lobes pushed apart along the line. Brownish fibrous strands emerge and persist at the interface between the white mass and the dark liquid near the center. Small dark specks on the white surface shift slightly during this motion. The dark-liquid level, the wall droplets, the left-side highlight, and the background remain essentially unchanged throughout. The framing stays static, holding the same view of the container as the line settles into place.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
